category_title: Struggling readers who forget intended dictation during technology delays
student_description: David is a student who struggles with the dual cognitive load of remembering his ideas while operating speech recognition (SR) technology. He frequently goes blank when initiating dictation and quickly loses interest when the technology times out or transcribes incorrectly. He uniquely requires immediate verbal reminders of his ideas and direct proxy dictation by the teacher when technology barriers arise, alongside long-term modeling of SR use and brainstorming.

criteria.rationale: David's cognitive load is overwhelmed by operating the SR tool, so he needs explicit verbal reminders of his intended phrases to proceed.
criteria.check: The tutor explicitly reminds the student of the specific phrase or idea they intended to dictate when they go blank.

criteria.rationale: Repeated SR failures cause David to lose interest, requiring the tutor to take over the dictation to guarantee a successful transcription and maintain engagement.
criteria.check: The tutor offers to dictate on the student's behalf, or directly does so, when the speech recognition technology repeatedly fails or causes frustration.
